# Acceptance tests, Platform

Tests for the Platform steps, in build order. Form and pass rule: [Acceptance tests](acceptance.md).

## Offline play

- **OFFLINE-01**: Setup: a browser with none of the game's files; the build on a local test server whose speed and connection the test controls; FirstLoadMax; LoadStep; GameLink. Do: open GameLink; cut the connection mid-load, then restore it; close the page mid-load, then open GameLink again; let the load finish. Repeat in a browser that refuses to keep files. Expect: [OFFLINE-01](../platform/offline-play.md#offline-01-first-load). **Derived:** all files as sent, compressed, total at most FirstLoadMax.
- **OFFLINE-02**: Setup: a browser that kept every file at OFFLINE-01; the connection off. Do: open GameLink; play order 1 Signing ceremony to its report; turn the connection on and open GameLink again. Expect: [OFFLINE-02](../platform/offline-play.md#offline-02-open).
- **OFFLINE-03**: Setup: a browser that kept the game under GameVersion; a test server now serving a build with GameVersion raised by one; one page of the game open on an order. Do: turn the connection off, then on; run the order to its report; open a second page; close every page; open GameLink. Repeat with the download cut off. Repeat with a save code from the later build read through LOAD SAVE CODE. Expect: [OFFLINE-03](../platform/offline-play.md#offline-03-new-version).

## Saving

- **SAVE-01**: Setup: a browser with storage on; a save with every order won up to order 16 Scrap drive; order 17 Night scrap run, a repair order, unwon; GameVersion. Do: in order 3 Diplomatic pouch place a wire, then undo it once and place it again; flip the AUDIO switch off; reload. In order 17 run a winning fix; close the game before the report prints; reopen. Run the winning fix again; close the page as the report starts to print; reopen and open order 17. Change one wiring in two pages. In two fresh browsers, one granting persistent storage and one refusing it, tap SAVE CODE; in the refusing one reload and tap it again; read the aid's request count after each tap. Check the browser's cookies. Expect: [SAVE-01](../platform/saving.md#save-01-keep). **Derived:** requests counted: 1 in each browser after its first tap; in the refusing one, still 1 after the reload, before and after the second tap.
- **SAVE-02**: Setup: a save with every order of act 1 won but order 5 Museum split; GameVersion. Do: win order 5; close the report; close the debrief; tap COPY and paste the clipboard into a text field; tap COPY in a browser that refuses the clipboard write; on the order list tap SAVE CODE. Expect: [SAVE-02](../platform/saving.md#save-02-copy-out).
- **SAVE-03**: Setup: browser A holds every order up to order 17 Night scrap run won; browser B holds every order up to order 16 Scrap drive won and a kept wiring in order 17; each holds filed reports, results found, best scores and a closed memo or debrief the other lacks; order 3 Diplomatic pouch's lamp lit in both, by different wins; order 4 Archive day's lamp lit in A only; A's save code, and one with a character changed. Do: in B tap LOAD SAVE CODE, paste A's code with spaces and line breaks inside, tap READ; read the order list, the archive, order 17, and the reports that lit orders 3 and 4's lamps. Paste the changed code. Paste A's code again. Close the field before READ. Paste a code from a build with GameVersion raised. Expect: [SAVE-03](../platform/saving.md#save-03-paste-in).
- **SAVE-04**: Setup: a browser whose storage rejects every write; a private window that keeps writes until it closes. Do: in the first, open the game, play through the opening misfire, win order 1 Signing ceremony, read the order list, reload. In the private window repeat, with no reload. Expect: [SAVE-04](../platform/saving.md#save-04-no-keeping).
- **SAVE-05**: Setup: a save kept under an earlier GameVersion: order 4 Archive day won with pars met and its lamp lit, filed reports, a kept wiring with undo steps, a result found; a build with GameVersion raised by one, order 4's batch changed so its fingerprint differs, and the result's text rewritten in its place. Do: open the game; open order 4; open the archive; close the game, open it again. In a second browser on the new build read a save code from the earlier GameVersion. Expect: [SAVE-05](../platform/saving.md#save-05-version).

## Settings

- **SETTING-01**: Setup: a browser with no setting kept; a music player playing; the test on a phone set to silent waits for the engine spike, [OQ-PLATFORM-05](../open-questions/platform.md#oq-platform-05-silent-switch). Do: with the music playing, flip the AUDIO switch off during the full alarm of the opening misfire; flip it on; repeat on the order list and the archive; reload. Expect: [SETTING-01](../platform/settings.md#setting-01-sound).
